summary: Master advanced OSINT and digital evidence gathering. Learn Maltego, Shodan, and forensic hashing to secure actionable intelligence. Enroll today.
lede: OSINT training helps investigators and security professionals collect, verify, and preserve publicly available information for investigations. It covers advanced search, infrastructure and social media analysis, geolocation, and documenting and hashing digital evidence. Learners also practice automated monitoring, checking potentially manipulated media, and presenting findings in clear intelligence reports.
audienceIntro: This training is essential for professionals tasked with uncovering hidden information and securing digital proof in complex environments.
modules: Dark Web and Deep Web Investigations
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of web technologies and networking concepts. Familiarity with command-line interfaces and basic cybersecurity principles is recommended. Note: You will need a laptop with the ability to run virtual machines for hands-on exercises.
